label: tetR/tetA promoters
note: The Tn10 divergent tetA/tetR control region: 56 bp carrying the PtetA promoter, the overlapping PtetR promoter, and the two TetR operators tetO1 and tetO2. The tetR promoters are not declared as sub-features. Daniels & Bertrand 1985 describe two, tetPR1 and tetPR2; Gulland & Hillen 1992 find that more than 95% of tetR mRNA in vivo starts at PR2, at a run of five A's, and the J01830 record places the tetR mRNA 5' end at 1544 -- that run (J01830 1540-1544 on the tetR strand), one base outside this 56 bp window. No accessible source gives the -35/-10 positions of either promoter. The reading consistent with the PR2 start (-35 TGGTAA at J01830 1574-1579, -10 TAGAGT at 1551-1556 on the tetR strand, 17 bp spacer, +1 7 bases on) has 7 of 12 consensus bases, too few to predict. Sub-features this part carried before put the tetR +1 at J01830 1564, inside tetO1, which the record and the five-A start contradict for PR2; whether they described PR1 is not established. The pRAB vectors' tetR promoter, a modified form of this region, is the catalog part PtetR* (pRAB).

label: PtetA -35
note: Canonical sigma70 -35 hexamer (TTGACA) of the tetA promoter (PtetA), reading 5'->3' into tetA.

label: PtetA -10
note: Degenerate sigma70 -10 hexamer (TTATTT) of PtetA, positioned with a canonical 17 bp -35/-10 spacer (sequence[7:24] = CTCTATCATTGATAGAG).

label: tetO1
note: 19 bp near-dyad TetR operator O1 (CACTCTATCATTGATAGAG), superimposed on the PtetA -10/spacer.

label: tetO2
note: 19 bp non-palindromic TetR operator O2 (TCCCTATCAGTGATAGAGA), the higher-affinity wild-type operator, superimposed on the divergent PtetR -10 region; O2 main...

label: PtetA +1
note: tetA transcription start site (+1): J01830 1581, the 5' end of the record's tetA mRNA, mapped by S1 analysis of tet mRNA 5' ends (Bertrand et al. 1983); 7 bases after the PtetA -10.
